caption.text:
You thought the waiting meant you were being overlooked. That maybe you weren’t chosen yet. That maybe you weren’t ready yet. That maybe something was wrong with you. But what if the waiting was never punishment—only preparation? What if the time it took wasn’t about delaying what you wanted, but about shaping you into someone who could actually hold it, keep it, and not lose yourself inside of it? Some things don’t arrive when you want them to. They arrive when you no longer need them to define you. And that changes everything.

— Read more in the book ‘Stay Single’ by Rebecca Simon 🖤
